scope: Fastify API contracts for health, readiness, invariants, wallet auth boundaries, evidence summaries, and idempotent workflows
implementedControls: health and readiness endpoints expose build, DB, chain, and SDK status
invariants endpoint exposes prohibited product drift and safety boundaries
wallet challenge endpoint creates login and exact-intent approval challenges without server signing
wallet verify endpoint rejects replayed nonces and invalid signatures
mutating workflow endpoints require Idempotency-Key headers
observation, settlement, and metric workflow endpoints use existing deterministic packages
evidence summary reports counts without secrets or unsupported profitability claims
